description:
Enhance and refactor DDL generation for remaining platforms that already have
partial or complete tuning implementations, aligning them with the new DDL
Generator Protocol from PT-01.

## Platforms Covered

### ClickHouse (Comprehensive - Refactor Only)
| Feature | Current State | Status |
|---------|---------------|--------|
| PARTITION BY | ClickHouseTuningMixin | Implemented |
| ORDER BY (sort/cluster) | ClickHouseTuningMixin | Implemented |
| MergeTree engines | ClickHouseTuningMixin | Implemented |
| OPTIMIZE TABLE | apply_table_tunings() | Implemented |

File: `benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/tuning.py` - **Already comprehensive, needs protocol alignment**

### Firebolt (Substantial - Refactor Only)
| Feature | Current State | Status |
|---------|---------------|--------|
| PRIMARY INDEX | generate_tuning_clause() | Implemented |
| PARTITION BY | generate_tuning_clause() | Implemented |
| AGGREGATING INDEX | generate_tuning_clause() | Partial |

File: `benchbox/platforms/firebolt.py` - **Substantial implementation, needs protocol alignment**

### Azure Synapse Dedicated SQL Pool (Substantial - Refactor Only)
| Feature | Current State | Status |
|---------|---------------|--------|
| DISTRIBUTION (HASH/ROUND_ROBIN) | generate_tuning_clause() | Implemented |
| CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX | generate_tuning_clause() | Implemented |
| HEAP tables | generate_tuning_clause() | Implemented |

File: `benchbox/platforms/azure_synapse.py` - **Substantial implementation, needs protocol alignment**

### Fabric Warehouse (Delta Lake - Shares with Spark)
| Feature | Current State | Status |
|---------|---------------|--------|
| OneLake Delta Tables | Inherits from Spark/Delta | To verify |
| PARTITION BY | Should inherit from Delta | To verify |
| OPTIMIZE | Should inherit from Delta | To verify |

File: `benchbox/platforms/fabric_warehouse.py` - **May share with PT-08 Spark Family**

### InfluxDB (Time-Series - Limited DDL)

| Bucket organization | API-based (not DDL) | N/A |

File: `benchbox/platforms/influxdb/adapter.py` - **Minimal DDL tuning (retention via API)**
